name: 子流程 - 查询客服日报

parameters.query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS report_date,
    COUNT(*) AS session_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(has_handoff), 0) AS handoff_sessions,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(has_handoff) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 0),
        2
    ) AS handoff_percentage,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(clarification_count), 0), 2)
        AS avg_clarifications,
    COALESCE(SUM(has_self_service), 0) AS self_service_sessions
FROM (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN route = 'handoff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS has_handoff,
        SUM(CASE WHEN route = 'ask_back' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS clarification_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN route IN ('rag', 'account') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS has_self_service
    FROM turn_log
    WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND created_at < CURDATE()
    GROUP BY session_id
) AS daily_sessions;
